sections.h2: 2. Pick the Sibling Builder bundle over separate sets
parts: The Sibling Builder bundle puts the 100-piece and 60-piece tile sets together with the 13-piece whiteboard tiles and markers for $77.97. Bought one by one, the same three sets cost $83.69 ($39.99 + $24.99 + $18.71), so the bundle saves $5.72 before the code and also ships free.
Not every bundle is cheaper: the STEM Motion bundle costs $59.97, the same as its three sets bought apart. It saves you picking the pieces, not money.

sections.h2: 3. Weigh the Elite Club only if you buy often
parts: The PicassoToys Elite Club costs $8.99 a month or $89.99 a year. Members get four special offers a year and see other promotions a week before the public. For one or two sets a year, the fee costs more than it saves. Promo codes can't be stacked with other offers unless the store says so.

PicassoTiles ships Monday to Friday to the 48 contiguous US states, within 3 to 15 business days of the order. It doesn't ship to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, other US territories or military addresses. Express 2-business-day shipping shows at checkout when the order qualifies, for an extra charge. The address can't be changed and the order can't be cancelled once it's placed.

Returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days of receipt for sets that are unopened, in the complete original box. Shipping costs aren't refunded, and you pay the return shipping. For a broken or defective set, email the store's support address with proof of purchase for a replacement.
